reconstructedwands.mode.construction.des: Extend the face you click across the matching blocks behind it.
reconstructedwands.mode.angel.desc: Place a block in mid-air, or behind the block you face.
reconstructedwands.mode.destruction.desc: Remove the exposed surface of matching blocks; their drops go to your inventory.
reconstructedwands.mode.exchange.desc: Swap a surface for the block in your offhand, keeping its orientation.
reconstructedwands.mode.architect.desc: Click two corners for a line, wall, floor, box or cube; for a circle or ring, click the centre, then the edge.
reconstructedwands.option.lock.desc: Only extend in one direction. Sneak + scroll to change.
reconstructedwands.option.direction.desc: Target: new blocks face like the blocks they extend. Player: like a block you place by hand.
reconstructedwands.option.replace.desc: Build over grass, flowers, snow and water.
reconstructedwands.option.match.desc: Which blocks count as the same. Similar: dirt and grass are one block (see server.json).
reconstructedwands.option.random.desc: Mix the blocks in your hotbar; each slot is one share.
reconstructedwands.option.shape.desc: What the Architect builds: a line, wall, floor, box or cube between two corners, or a circle or ring around the first click. Sneak + scroll to change.
reconstructedwands.tooltip.controls: G or Sneak + right-click: settings · R: modes
reconstructedwands.tooltip.core_install: Craft with a wand to install
reconstructedwands.problem.broken: The wand is out of durability
reconstructedwands.problem.no_block: No block to place: aim at one or hold one in your offhand
reconstructedwands.problem.no_replacemen: Hold the new block in your offhand
reconstructedwands.problem.no_items: You have none of these blocks
reconstructedwands.problem.too_big: Too big: this wand builds at most %s blocks
reconstructedwands.message.corner_set: First corner at %s, %s, %s. Click the second corner.
reconstructedwands.message.undo_blocked: Cannot undo: %s, %s, %s has changed or is protected
reconstructedwands.message.undo_needs_dr: Undo needs the blocks you got back in your inventory
reconstructedwands.screen.wheel_hint: Point at a mode and let go
reconstructedwands.screen.bound: Takes blocks from the container at %s, %s, %s
reconstructedwands.screen.bind_hint: Sneak + right-click a chest to take blocks from it
reconstructedwands.screen.controls: Ctrl + scroll: size · Sneak + scroll: lock or shape
reconstructedwands.command.reload_failed: The config could not be reloaded
reconstructedwands.screen.controls2: Ctrl + Z / Ctrl + Y: undo, redo · R: mode wheel
